items.question: In July 2014, what sulphur content in parts per million (ppm) did the UAE's green diesel requirement set for commercial diesel vehicles?
items.gold: Diesel with only 10 ppm of sulphur, similar to Euro 5 standards.
items.fact: UAE green diesel mandate sets 10 ppm sulphur limit

items.question: By what percentage did the Abu Dhabi National Oil Company (ADNOC) group reduce natural gas flaring by 2013?
items.gold: ADNOC had reduced flaring by 76.4 per cent in 2013.
items.fact: ADNOC reduced natural gas flaring by 76.4 percent by 2013
